answer: Clawback vesting at the spiral: rewards unlock over 90 days, revocable if collusion is proven. An atlas of stake-weighted identity proofs gates each withdrawal, so one actor needs N distinct bonds. Quartz-locked escrow means a 100-identity farm forfeits ~9,000 in slashed payouts before profit turns positive. Delay converts cheap sybil minting into expensive capital lockup, making attacks net-negative.
